About the Role

We are looking for a new graduate Software Engineer to join XPENG’s Computing Platform team. We build a unified compute platform that provides core AI infrastructure for autonomous driving, robotics, and intelligent cockpit applications.

Our platform supports batch and real-time streaming data processing at a scale of hundreds of millions of records per day.
